verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk uniformly. At 300x250 the SOLSTICE logo, the NEW FLAVOR badge, the subtitle and even the CTA label are too small to read, and the large empty band around the small can wastes the space. B actually rearranges the layout: the headline and CTA are large and clearly the main elements, and the subtitle can be read. But the SOLSTICE wordmark has shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-right corner (a brand failure), the NEW FLAVOR badge is jammed against the headline, and the can is so small that it looks like an afterthought squeezed between the subtitle and the CTA.
